name: Example: Night Watch
description: Tier-3 example mod, in Lua. Keeps a tally of zombie kills, blocks mined and nights survived in the world save, pays a bounty of arrows every 25 kills, hands out supplies at the dawn after a horde night, and adds console commands: mod.example_scripted.stats, mod.example_scripted.beacon and mod.example_scripted.selftest.
